posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina delighted fans with her May photo dump featuring rare family moments with Vicky Kaushal and baby Vihaan, including a heartwarming snap of tiny hands during storytime.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Imtiaz Ali-directed Main Vaapas Aaunga releases June 12, while Sardaar Ji 3 skips India release amid backlash over Pakistani actress casting. AURA Tour 2026 continues to sell out globally.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's YRF Spy Universe debut Alpha releases July 10 with Sharvari and Bobby Deol, featuring SRK's rumored Pathaan cameo. Also gearing up for Love & War with Ranbir and Vicky this Christmas.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Jee Le Zaraa with Alia and Katrina is moving forward with Farhan Akhtar completing location scouting. SRK reportedly in talks for a cameo in the much-awaited female road trip film.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King reconfirmed for Christmas 2026 release with daughter Suhana Khan's big-screen debut, Deepika Padukone, and Abhishek Bachchan. The action thriller carries a massive ₹350-400 crore budget.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo returns to the big screen with Daayra, a gritty thriller directed by Raazi-fame Meghna Gulzar alongside Malayalam superstar Prithviraj Sukumaran. Her first release since The Buckingham Murders.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Post Stree 2 blockbuster, Shraddha has signed a Rs 17 crore deal plus profit-sharing for a high-concept thriller with Ekta Kapoor, directed by Tumbbad's Rahi Anil Barve. Stree 3 is also in the pipeline.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is using a body double for action sequences in SRK's King due to her pregnancy, while also joining Allu Arjun in Atlee's Raka. VFX will seamlessly integrate her close-ups with stunt footage.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: After Dhurandhar 2's historic ₹1,800+ crore worldwide run, Ranveer begins shooting the post-apocalyptic thriller Pralay in August with a ₹300 crore budget and AI-driven visuals.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 in a Banarasi saree with bold sindoor, recreating her iconic 2002 debut look. JW Marriott also appointed her as their global brand ambassador for luxury travel.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Newlywed Rashmika's wedding post with Vijay Deverakonda became Asia's most-liked Instagram post at 23.8M likes. She stars in Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor releasing June 19, and reunites with Allu Arjun in Atlee's AA22xA6.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's action comeback Maa Inti Bangaram releases June 19 — she plays a fierce daughter-in-law hiding a dangerous past. The trailer showcases her in a never-before-seen action avatar with saree-clad fight sequences.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's ambitious sci-fi film AA22xA6 with director Atlee is in production, featuring Deepika, Janhvi, Mrunal, and a Pushpa reunion with Rashmika. Set in a parallel universe with a massive multi-starrer cast.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama Peddi opened massive, crossing ₹100 crore worldwide on Day 1 and beating Dhurandhar, Pathaan and Raja Saab records. The AR Rahman-scored film co-stars Janhvi Kapoor.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Bollywood debut War 2 with Hrithik Roshan is set for August 14 release. He's also in talks with Hi Nanna director Shouryuv for an ambitious 2-part action drama.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in the blockbuster Peddi, which crossed ₹100 crore worldwide on opening day. She also has a key role in Allu Arjun and Atlee's sci-fi spectacle AA22xA6.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's Chand Mera Dil crossed ₹18.96 crore in its first week despite online trolling over a fusion Bharatanatyam sequence. Call Me Bae Season 2 on Prime Video is also in the works.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara plays the female lead in the mega-budget War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR, part of YRF's Spy Universe. The action thriller hits theaters on August 14.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik praised Jr NTR as his 'favourite co-star' ahead of their epic dance-off in War 2, calling it 'electrifying.' The YRF Spy Universe sequel releases August 14 in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai released June 5, directed by father David Dhawan. He also featured in Border 2 with Sunny Deol and Diljit Dosanjh, which hit ₹294 crore in two weeks.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya kicks off The Unstoppable Tour this month with shows in Auckland, Perth, Sydney, and Melbourne, followed by a massive US leg spanning Boston, Newark, Toronto, Texas, and Oakland in September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is scoring three of 2026's biggest films: Ram Charan's blockbuster Peddi, Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga, and the epic Ramayana alongside Hans Zimmer. A year of landmark collaborations.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's final film Jananayagan is eyeing a massive summer release, with his online Thalapathy Kacheri event pulling 2.5 million real-time views. The ₹500+ crore farewell spectacle has fans in a frenzy.
